name: Wedding Editorial
description: Tattva Weddings editorial — Soft Ivory surfaces, elegant serif titles, Deep Crimson accents (not generic gold/bronze). Macro-inspired spacing only; not Macro branding.

title.fallback: Cormorant Garamond, Libre Baskerville, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
title.note: OFFICIAL FONT NOT SHIPPED — Bizantheum files not in store; do not extract from PDFs. Google-licensed Cormorant Garamond used as elegant editorial serif stand-in until owner supplies licensed files.

subheading.note: Canela Trial — trial licensing; do not embed trial files in production without a license. Fallback serif only until owner supplies licensed Canela (or approved substitute).

body.fallback: system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
body.note: Poppins Light preferred when self-hosted licensed files are available. PicPeak CSS sanitizer BLOCKS @import of Google Fonts CDN — do not rely on external @import in gallery.css. System UI light stack used until owner supplies files or a sanitizer-safe font path.

colours.note: Owner-supplied Tattva palette (2026-10-23 brand specs image). Soft Ivory backgrounds; Deep Crimson for selected UI accents. NOT gold/bronze wedding defaults.
